source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Null Hypothesis (H0)' under topic 7.2 (PDF 94, printed 90).

blocks.text: Null hypothesis kehta hai ke koi asar (effect) ya farq (difference) nahi hai. Ise default assumption (pehle se maani hui baat) ke taur par likha jata hai. Data ko isi hypothesis ke khilaf test kiya jata hai. Agar saboot mazboot ho to null hypothesis reject (radd) kar diya jata hai. Ise aam taur par H₀ se dikhaya jata hai. Null hypothesis bias se bachata hai aur muqable (comparison) ki bunyad deta hai. Bohat se tests isi hypothesis se shuru hote hain, aur faisla karne mein yeh aham hai.
